AssignedFlow.description:
Fixed flow out of (demand, positive) or into (supply, negative) the network at its port,
whatever the pressure there, which is a result (SDD §4.11). Not a fixed-pressure boundary:
it never satisfies NO_FIXED_HEAD. A flow of 0 behaves exactly as a plug.

FlowCoefficient.description:
Valve resistance exactly as the user entered it.

K is dimensionless. Cv is US gpm of water at 1 psi pressure drop; Kv is m³/h of water at
1 bar. Cv and Kv are defined quantities, so they are stored as entered (the one exception
to SI storage) and converted to K at the connected inner diameter by the solver.

pressureLoss.description: The datasheet pressure drop at the rated flow, Pa (a difference), as the loss of total pressure from inlet to outlet: the dissipative loss (friction and form), without the static head between the ports. Keep the ports at their real elevations; a datasheet's static drop S between nozzles at different elevations or bores is entered as S - ρ_r g (z_out - z_in) - ρ_r (v_out² - v_in²)/2, with the nozzle velocities at the rated flow

StateChange.title: StateChange

assignedFlowNodeIds.description: beyond_limit, below_floor: the assigned-flow nodes whose flows the bound counts, in the message's order (id order); empty otherwise
assignedFlowNodeIds.title: Assignedflownodeids

componentIds.description: The pumps and valves the message names, in its order; empty when it names none or the point has a head. not_converged: /solve's convergence.oscillatingComponents for that solve (see reason), maybe none, and the message may name other elements, in its words only
componentIds.title: Componentids

converged.description: True when the point has a head: its solve converged to a steady state that carries the flow with a determined head
converged.title: Converged

flow.description: m³/s through the pump, suction -> discharge
flow.title: Flow

head.description: EGL(discharge) - EGL(suction), m: the head the pump must add at this flow; null when no steady state carries the flow, its head is undetermined or its solve did not converge (see reason and message)
head.title: Head

limitFlow.description: m³/s. beyond_limit: the most the pump can pass (negative: the reverse flow it would have to pass is -limitFlow); below_floor: the least it must pass; null otherwise
limitFlow.title: Limitflow

message.description: Why the point has no head ('' when it has one)
message.title: Message

npshAvailable.description: NPSHa at the pump's suction at this flow, m: (EGL_s - z_s) + (p_atm - p_vap)/(ρg), as the solve's npshAvailable; null when the point has no head, the fluid has no vapor pressure, or the suction's pressure level is undetermined
npshAvailable.title: Npshavailable

openHead.description: m. valve_at_switch: the head across the pump with the valve fully open, the bound of the heads the throttled valve could hold; null otherwise
openHead.title: Openhead

openHeadBound.description: valve_at_switch: 'lower' when any head at or above openHead holds, 'upper' when any head at or below it does; null otherwise
openHeadBound.title: Openheadbound

passedFlow.description: m³/s. beyond_limit, below_floor: what componentIds pass that way together (0: no flow); null otherwise
passedFlow.title: Passedflow

reason.description: Why the point has no head, as a code (null when it has one); message says the same in words, and the other fields hold the ids and numbers it quotes, but for not_converged and not_computed only what is said of them here. no_way_through: a side of the pump reaches no reservoir or reference node, nor the pump's other side, through elements that can open (all but those closed by a status the user set), so no steady state carries a forced flow (at flow 0: the head across the pump is undetermined). beyond_limit: every way from the pump's discharge back to its suction passes componentIds, which together pass at most passedFlow that way; the pump can pass at most limitFlow (with the flows of assignedFlowNodeIds, when any; a negative limitFlow: it would have to pass -limitFlow in reverse, so no forced flow, zero included, has a steady state). below_floor: every way from the pump's suction to its discharge passes componentIds, which together pass at most passedFlow that way, and with the flows of assignedFlowNodeIds the pump must pass at least limitFlow. no_steady_state_found: from every start in startsTried the status rules close componentIds (maybe none), which leaves a side of the pump with no way to a reservoir or reference node. free_level: a side of the pump (closed off by componentIds, when any) is in a part of the network that carries flow but reaches no reservoir or reference node, so its head is undetermined. closed_off: componentIds (when any) close off a side of the pump, and nothing fixes the pressure in the part closed off (the message says 'at zero flow' at flow 0). valve_at_switch: the control valve componentIds[0] sits at its switch (an FCV passing exactly its setpoint, a PRV with its outlet or a PSV with its inlet at its setting) and could also hold the flow throttled, with any head across the pump on openHeadBound's side of openHead, and nothing fixes the pressure between it and the pump. not_converged: the solve did not converge, and the outer loop's own words follow 'not converged: ' in message; componentIds are what /solve reports for that solve as convergence.oscillatingComponents: the controls and branches the outer loop names as oscillating, still changing or over-controlled, maybe none. Other elements and nodes its words name (the assigned-flow nodes of a part no reservoir or reference node reaches and the elements closed around it, a wye in a flow pattern with no cited correlation) are in message only. not_computed: the request's time budget (its seconds in message only) ran out before the point was solved
reason.title: Reason

startsTried.description: no_steady_state_found: the starts the point was solved from, in the message's order: solve (the network's own solve), previous_point (the last converged point's solution), initial (the network's initial state), initial_open (that state with its control valves open); empty otherwise
startsTried.title: Startstried

WyeBranch.description:
Wye (lateral): 'inlet' and 'outlet_1' are the straight run, 'outlet_2' the angled leg.

Orientation: the angled leg leans toward 'outlet_1' (flow from 'inlet' turns through the
wye's angle into 'outlet_2'). Crane's lateral data cover the combined flow through
'inlet', dividing or combining; with the combined flow through 'outlet_1' and flow in
'outlet_2', that flow turns through 180° minus the angle, and the result is flagged.

angle.description: Angle between the angled leg (outlet_2) and the run, degrees, with the leg leaning toward outlet_1; Crane covers 30-60 with the combined flow through the inlet
angle.title: Angle

info.description: Steady-state hydraulic analysis of pressurized pipe networks. All values are SI. Free software (AGPL-3.0-or-later): GET /source redirects to the source code of the commit this server runs, and GET /api/v1/about names it.
info.title: OpenSolve Pipe API

get.description: The server's version and the source code of the commit it runs (AGPL-3.0 §13).

Built-in fluids with the temperature and concentration ranges CoolProp supports for them
(a glycol's lower temperature bound is its freezing point at the concentration), whether a
vapor pressure is available, and their sources.

post.description: Validate a user-defined fluid and return its properties as the solver will use them.

400.description: Invalid input, or a fluid state out of range

post.description:
Properties of a fluid definition (the project's ``fluid``: a built-in fluid at its
temperature and glycol mass fraction, with any overrides, or a custom fluid) as the solver
will use them, SI, with the source of each value.

The definition travels in the request body, which the server never logs (SDD §7.3); the web
app uses this endpoint. ``fluid`` in the response is the built-in fluid's id, or 'custom'.

400.description: Invalid input, or a fluid state out of range

get.description:
Properties of a library fluid at a temperature (and glycol mass fraction), SI.

For API users. The fluid and its values travel in the URL: the server's access log keeps
only the path, but proxies and other intermediaries may log the whole URL, query string
included. POST /api/v1/fluids/properties sends them in the body instead.

400.description: Invalid input, or a fluid state out of range

post.description:
Find the variable values that bring the goals to their targets (PRD §3.9). Every
evaluation is a full solve of the case (the base project, or scenarioId) with the variables
written on top; the project is never changed: each variable's override applies the value
found. A goal not met is 200 with success = false; computeTime is the worker's time.

Checks in order: the scenario (404, then 400 for its values), the case's fluid (400),
unknown elements, ports and pipes (404, all listed), inputs that do not apply (400, by
index), the case's topology (422), the bounds (400); then the search, always 200 unless its
first evaluation runs out of time (503 TIMEOUT). At most one goal seek runs in the worker
pool at a time (503 SERVER_BUSY).

404.description: Unknown scenario, element, port or pipe

503.description: Server busy (SERVER_BUSY) or the time budget ran out (TIMEOUT)

get.description: Pipe materials (sizes, dimensions, roughness, sources) and fitting types.
Calculation-method versions and what changed in each (GOALS §4.3).

post.description:
Solve the network, or one of its scenarios (scenarioId: its overrides are applied to the
base project first). Non-convergence returns 200 with success = false (SDD §8.1).
computeTime is the solver's own time, without waiting for a worker (workers.py).

503.description: Server busy (SERVER_BUSY) or the time budget ran out (TIMEOUT)

post.description:
System curve seen by one pump: the head it must add at each flow (design §13), in the
base project or one of its scenarios (scenarioId).

At each flow the pump is replaced by that fixed flow and the network solved; other pumps
keep running. Default range: 0 to 1.2 x the curve's largest flow x the pump's speed.
Unknown scenario id, then invalid scenario values (400), then an unknown pump id: 404
NOT_FOUND; topology and fluid errors as for /solve.

404.description: Unknown pump id or scenario id

503.description: Server busy (SERVER_BUSY) or the time budget ran out (TIMEOUT)

get.description:
Redirects to the source code of the commit this server runs (AGPL-3.0 §13), or to the
repository when the image records no commit. 302, not a permanent redirect: the next
deployment runs another commit.
